For the first time in thirty years, he left the door unlocked and put another cup beside his own.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯把空荡的街道照成淡金色，清洁工推着车，扫起昨夜遗落的喧闹。早餐铺掀开蒸笼，白汽轻轻碰着雨棚。远处一辆末班车驶过，车窗里只有几个疲惫的影子。天边还没亮，鸟却先醒了，在楼宇之间试探着叫了一声，仿佛替所有熟睡的人确认，新的一天正在靠近。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same method on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box that contains a smaller box, then opening that one the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you reach a box with no smaller box inside."}
